clue.text: Model recalls sitting to get large property in Scotland

indicators.note: to model something is to shape or form it anew, so these letters are reshaped into another order

explanation.surface: A fashion model remembers posing for a portrait and ends up owning a Scottish estate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Model' looks like the subject of the sentence, but it is the signal to rearrange RECALLS SITTING.
explanation.definitionFit: The castle at Stirling is a historic fortress and royal residence, a very large property in Scotland.

clue.text: Curse about security device for money

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the curse word goes around the other piece

parts.note: a bane is a curse or source of ruin
a knot secures a rope, so it serves as a security device

explanation.surface: Someone swears at an anti-theft gadget.
explanation.definitionFit: A paper note issued by a bank is a form of currency, so it stands for money.

clue.text: Pro in examination — it can cause stress

indicators.note: in places the word for pro inside the letters for the examination

parts.note: GCE, the General Certificate of Education, is a British school examination
pro means in favour of, i.e. for

explanation.surface: Sitting a professional exam is stressful.
explanation.walkthrough: GCE was the British school-leaving qualification (O and A levels).
explanation.definitionFit: Acceleration measured in multiples of gravity puts physical strain on pilots and astronauts.

clue.text: Fraud lifted coats

indicators.note: in a down entry, lifted means the word reads upwards, so it is turned backwards

parts.note: macs are raincoats, short for mackintoshes

explanation.surface: A con involving stolen coats.
explanation.definitionFit: A swindle or con is a fraudulent scheme.

clue.text: Thin permit providing weighty protection

parts.note: gaunt means lean and haggard, thin
to let is to permit or allow

explanation.surface: A flimsy licence that nonetheless offers solid protection.
explanation.definitionFit: An armoured glove of steel plates is heavy hand protection worn by knights.

clue.text: Trouble's arisen with European ship inside port

indicators.note: inside places the European and ship letters within the reversed trouble word
in a down entry, arisen means the word goes upwards, so it reads backwards

parts.note: ado is trouble or fuss; the 's reads as 'has', joining it to arisen
SS is the abbreviation for steamship

explanation.surface: A problem has come up because a European vessel is in harbour.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down answer 'arisen' means read upwards, giving ODA; 'Trouble's' is read as 'Trouble has', so the 's is part of the reversal's signal.
explanation.definitionFit: The Ukrainian city on the Black Sea is a major seaport.

clue.text: Trade campaign haunts vehicle inspectors

parts.note: traffic means trade or dealing, as in drug traffic
a war is a campaign, as in a war on litter
dens are haunts or hideaways

explanation.surface: A commercial campaign is troubling the people who check vehicles.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain these officials patrol streets checking parked cars and issuing parking tickets.
explanation.definitionFit: These uniformed officials examine parked cars to enforce parking rules, so they inspect vehicles.

clue.text: Any in audition to get such direction shortly

definitions.text: Any in audition to get such direction shortly

parts.words: Any in audition to get such direction shortly
parts.note: 'any' said aloud sounds like the letters N E, the short form of a compass direction; heading 'to' that direction is going that way

explanation.surface: Anyone at an audition is told how to get somewhere.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Any' spoken sounds like NE, which is the abbreviation ('shortly') of a compass point; moving towards that direction gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Heading in the direction between north and east is moving towards the abbreviated point NE.

clue.text: Comparatively skint dealer

definitions.meaning: skint is slang for having no money, so comparatively skint means more penniless
an agent who buys and sells on others' behalf, as on the stock market

explanation.surface: A trader who is poorer than another.
explanation.definitionFit: One sense is the comparative of a slang word for penniless; the other is an agent who trades shares or goods.

clue.text: Small filthy place housing Republican government department

parts.note: mini means small

indicators.note: housing means containing, so the filthy place holds the Republican letter

parts.note: a sty, a pigsty, is a filthy place

explanation.surface: A cramped, dirty building where a Republican is lodged.
explanation.definitionFit: In Britain, a major branch of the state such as Defence is called a Ministry.

clue.text: Material underfoot left strewn around Moulin Rouge at the end

indicators.note: strewn around means scattered about, so the letters are rearranged
at the end picks out the final letter of Rouge

explanation.surface: Something is scattered all over the floor of the famous Paris cabaret.
explanation.walkthrough: 'strewn around' is the anagram signal for MOULIN plus E, the last letter of 'Rouge'.
explanation.definitionFit: Lino is a durable floor covering, so it is a material walked on.

clue.text: Note a bird having tail cut off's beastly cry

parts.note: mi is a note in the sol-fa scale

indicators.note: having its tail cut off means the last letter of the bird is removed

parts.note: an owl is a bird

explanation.surface: A bird whose tail has been docked lets out an animal cry.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's is read as 'is', a link to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A cat's call is an animal's cry, and a beast is any animal.

clue.text: Turner's equipment encompasses oils primarily, not stand

indicators.note: encompasses means surrounds, so the equipment goes around the other letter

parts.note: a lathe is the machine used by a turner, a person who shapes wood or metal; not the painter Turner

indicators.note: primarily picks out the first letter of oils

explanation.surface: J.M.W. Turner's painting kit includes oils but he can't stand.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Turner' suggests the painter, which fits 'oils', but here it is a woodturner.
explanation.definitionFit: To be unable to stand something is to detest or hate it.

clue.text: Roman in conclusion repelled monster

indicators.note: repelled means driven back, so the word is turned backwards

parts.note: ergo is Latin, the Romans' language, for therefore, i.e. in conclusion

explanation.surface: A Roman soldier finally fought off a monster.
explanation.definitionFit: A man-eating giant of fairy tales is a classic monster.

clue.text: That woman mostly behind swindle

indicators.note: mostly means all but the last letter is kept

parts.note: she refers to that woman
aft means behind, at the back of a ship

explanation.surface: A woman is behind a fraud.
explanation.definitionFit: To be shafted is slang for being cheated, so to do this to someone is to swindle them.

clue.text: Overcome runt with sumo wrestling

indicators.note: wrestling suggests a tussle, the letters grappled into a new order

explanation.surface: A small weakling beats opponents at sumo wrestling.
explanation.definitionFit: To get the better of an obstacle is to overcome it.

clue.text: Pick up remedy with the other hand finally

indicators.note: the final letter, L for left, is switched to the other hand, R for right

parts.note: to heal is to remedy or cure

explanation.surface: Someone finally turns to the other hand for a cure.
explanation.walkthrough: L (left) at the end becomes R (right).
explanation.definitionFit: To pick up a sound or a rumour is to catch it with the ears.

clue.text: One wearing headgear gets through gaps

indicators.note: wearing headgear puts the single letter inside the hat

parts.note: a hat is headgear
I is the Roman numeral for one
to get through something is to use it up

explanation.surface: Someone in a hat squeezes through gaps.
explanation.definitionFit: Breaks or pauses in continuity are gaps.

clue.text: Strike in Birmingham, mercifully not all of it

indicators.note: not all of it says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: An industrial strike in Birmingham, thankfully not citywide.
explanation.definitionFit: To hit something hard, as with a mallet, is to strike it.

clue.text: Lady abroad produced sandwiches in the morning

indicators.note: sandwiches means encloses, so the produced word holds the morning letters

parts.note: made means produced
AM, ante meridiem, means in the morning

explanation.surface: A foreign woman made sandwiches before noon.
explanation.definitionFit: The French form of address for a married woman is the overseas equivalent of a lady.

clue.text: Careful to include storm cover

indicators.note: to include means containing, so the careful word holds the storm word

parts.note: wary means careful
to storm is to rant and rage

explanation.surface: Be careful that your insurance covers storm damage.
explanation.definitionFit: A guarantee on goods provides cover against faults.

clue.text: King with posh car to enter once more

parts.note: R is short for rex, Latin for king
the E-Type is a classic Jaguar sports car

explanation.surface: A king arrives again in a luxury car.
explanation.walkthrough: The E-Type Jaguar is a famous 1960s British sports car.
explanation.definitionFit: To key in text a second time is to enter it again.

clue.text: Workshops interrupted by posh academic

indicators.note: interrupted by means the posh letter breaks into the workshops word

parts.note: studios are workshops for artists
U means upper-class, posh

explanation.surface: Art workshops disrupted by an upper-class scholar.
explanation.definitionFit: A bookish, scholarly person is diligent in study.

clue.text: Love hotel in very fashionable part of London

indicators.note: in places the love and hotel letters inside the very word

parts.note: so means very
love is zero in tennis, O
H is hotel in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A romantic hotel in a trendy London district.
explanation.definitionFit: This West End district is a trendy area of central London known for nightlife.

clue.text: Couple is able to hear bird

indicators.note: to hear says the words are taken by their sound

parts.note: a couple is two, and is able means can

explanation.surface: A pair can listen to a bird.
explanation.definitionFit: This big-billed tropical American species is a bird.

clue.text: Continental pastoral worker's dog

parts.note: a German is from continental Europe
a shepherd tends flocks in pasture

explanation.surface: A European sheep farmer's dog.
explanation.definitionFit: This large wolf-like breed, also called Alsatian, is a dog.
